CustomField.description: The finance coding this grant's revenue posts against, as it appears in the accounting system. Mirrors the Cost Center / Revenue Code pair carried on Gift Designation - see docs/gift-designation-financial-attribution.md - but is captured here so the coding is known at award time, before any reimbursement is designated.
